shared_elements: standing human figures in a scene
central figure flanked by smaller/subsidiary figures
dense field of small repeated script-like signs
raised-relief carving on a flat panel
offering/altar-like object at the base of the scene
disc or rounded element above the figures
justification: Both surfaces depict a shallow-relief figural scene with a principal standing human figure attended by smaller flanking figures, set above or beside an offering/altar-like object, and both combine the figural panel with extensive fields of small, repeated glyph-like signs — a fairly specific pairing of figural tableau plus dense script. However, the figural conventions differ markedly: A shows slender, nude-outlined, gesturing figures with a prominent radiant disc dominating the upper field and long horizontal bands of tiny signs, while B shows a heavily costumed, frontally posed figure with elaborate headdress and ornamental panels of large blocky signs below, so the shared traits could plausibly arise independently in any monumental commemorative tradition.
